Dear Students
I hope you are keeping yourself sane and healthy in this time of crisis. However, all the institutions might prolong their closure till Eid. I kind of find peace in learning and helping others learn. Having said that I would really like to help you with your academic efforts and assignments. This in NO WAY an attempt of spoon-feeding anyone. I would rather help you with insights and resources only if you are eager to learn.
